customers_say: Customers find the digital lock to be a good home security solution with feature-rich functionality and easy installation. They appreciate its usability, with one customer noting it's convenient for different family members to use. The value for money receives mixed feedback, with some finding it good for the price while others consider it costly.

reviews.title: Good lock with nice features
reviews.body: I am a medium user, for me it serves the purpose well. The camera option serves well for doors without an eye piece. It need 2.4ghz wifi for functioning, and doesn't work with 5g connection. Hence, make sure u ask ur internet provider for the specified frequency. Installation went pretty smooth without any hassle, service people were well equipped and made a good job without any damage to the door.
